_notes: How chain-level fees appear on city location tables. Every fee id must exist in data/providers/fees.csv; build fails otherwise. sort_fee_id is the published dollar figure used to sort (official maximum, single fee, or the top of a published range). A null sort_fee_id means no fee is published, and the text must say 'Not published, call ahead'. Edit wording here, not in page files. These are chain policies, not a store's till price.

walmart.text: $1 maximum. Walmart says exact charges vary by location but won't be over $1. Cash or debit.

usps.text: $2.65 for $0.01–$500.00; $3.75 for $500.01–$1,000.00 (national USPS fees). $1,000 limit per money order. Cash or debit, not credit.

king_soopers.text: Not published, call ahead. King Soopers says the cost of a money order will vary by state. Cash or debit.

walmart.text: $4 maximum for pre-printed checks up to $1,000; $8 maximum above $1,000. Two-party personal checks: limited to $200, $6 maximum.

king_soopers.text: Not published, call ahead. King Soopers says fees and limits vary by state, and that it accepts checks up to $5,000.

walmart.text: Starts at $1 and varies by biller and speed (no maximum published). Cash or debit; photo ID may be required over $900.
$0–$3.74 per transaction (published range); $20–$1,000 per transaction; up to 3 per day.
